findings.quote: a champion of the global debate on global governance of artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Praises the Secretary-General for advancing global debate on AI governance.

findings.quote: The voice of Africans must be heard in all circumstances, at all times, in strategic decision-making processes on issues of peace, global security, financing for development as well as climate issues and global governance of artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Calls for African participation in global AI governance decisions.

findings.quote: Today, peoples and nations have an opportunity to make a qualitative leap in their overall living conditions through fair financing mechanisms for development and tools provided by artificial intelligence in order to improve education, health, agriculture, public service, scientific research and economic productivity.
findings.rationale: Supports AI-enabled development, inclusive human-centered governance through the Global Digital Compact, capacity building, digital infrastructure and international cooperation.
